meanings.note: Relational adjective formed with the Slavic suffix '-ский' ('pertaining to'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('old-fashioned').

examples.trans: No, this is my grandfather's antique.
This is an old grandfather's watch.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.

meanings.note: About people. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('kind; good').
in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

meanings.note: Synonym of едва. Core Russian adv meaning 'barely, hardly' in everyday speech.

examples.text: Он так устал, что еле шёл домой.
examples.trans: He was so tired that he could barely walk home.

examples.text: Аркашка, ты еле стираешь! Сильнее три!
examples.trans: Arkashka, you're barely washing! Rub harder!

meanings.note: Спасибо за + accusative. Core Russian prep meaning 'for; behind' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Never changes its form; masculine. Common masculine noun meaning 'coffee' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

meanings.note: Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to buy', paired with 'покупать'.

examples.text: Юле бы дублёнку купили, Славику бы ноутбук.
examples.trans: We could have bought Yulia a sheepskin coat, and Slavik a laptop.

meanings.note: Agrees with the thing owned. Core Russian det meaning 'my, mine' in everyday speech.
+ infinitive. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'can, to be able', paired with 'смочь'.

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'celebrate, mark'.

examples.text: Я не буду отмечать день рождения.
examples.trans: I will not celebrate my birthday.

examples.text: Я в этом году не буду шумно отмечать день рождения.
examples.trans: This year I will not noisily celebrate my birthday.

examples.text: Вся команда кухни собралась вечером отмечать общую победу.
examples.trans: The whole kitchen team gathered in the evening to celebrate their shared victory.

посидеть.gloss: to sit for a while; to stay (with someone)

meanings.note: Perfective of limited duration. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'сидеть'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to sit for a while; to stay (with someone)', paired with 'сидеть'.

Посиди с ним = stay with him. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'сидеть'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to sit for a while; to stay (with someone)', paired with 'сидеть'.

examples.trans: Stay with Vika for a while.
Let's sit in a café for a bit.

examples.text: Слушай, я уеду на полтора часа. Ты с Викой посиди, понял?
examples.trans: Listen, I'm going out for an hour and a half. You stay with Vika, got it?

meanings.note: takes the accusative; everyday synonym of о

examples.text: Как интересно! А в Москве ты про меня гадости рассказываешь.

meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'wake up'.

examples.trans: Vika, are you awake already today?

meanings.note: 'это просто' = it's easy. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: День рождения = birthday. Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'birth' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Смотрите, врунишка новую машину купил! У врунишки сегодня день рождения!
examples.trans: Look, the little liar bought a new car! It's the little liar's birthday today!

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: Prepare hot soup or meal. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'варить'). Used as a perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to cook, boil (soup)', paired with 'варить'.

examples.text: Сегодня на кухне сварили вкусный суп.
examples.trans: Today in the kitchen they cooked delicious soup.

examples.text: А вы решили сварить мужу борщ?
